excluded_measurement_attempts.command: measure.py before asynchronous stdout drain correction
excluded_measurement_attempts.cause: Measurement script sampled PSS before draining stdout, so native tools/list blocked on the pipe and hit the 40-second bound. Cleanup also initially expected an object where mcporter daemon status returns null when stopped.
excluded_measurement_attempts.correction: Drain stdout/stderr with communicate while a separate sampler collects smaps_rollup. Accept the native null stopped-status value.
excluded_measurement_attempts.measurement_use: Excluded; this was trial instrumentation failure, not an MCP client failure.

native_argument_setup_observations.command: mcpdo --config <lane-config> servers/show trial-ai-memory with MCP_CATALOG_PATH also set
native_argument_setup_observations.cause: Vendor rejects combining read-only --config and writable catalog selection.
native_argument_setup_observations.correction: Use --config only, with MCP_STORAGE_DIR and private daemon directory for isolation.

native_argument_setup_observations.cause: Target after flags is not consumed as a target by the shipped CLI parser.
native_argument_setup_observations.correction: Verified mcp-inspector --cli <URL> --method tools/list --transport http --format json returns rc 0 on the same host.
